gloss: overlooking; missing; letting pass; catch-up viewing

definitions.explanation: failing to see or notice something, whether accidentally or intentionally
watching a TV program after its original broadcast, typically via streaming services

examples.japanese: {大事|だいじ}な{点|てん}を{見逃|みのが}ししてしまった。
examples.english: I ended up missing an important point.

examples.japanese: {絶対|ぜったい}に{見逃|みのが}しできないチャンスだ。
examples.english: This is a chance I absolutely cannot miss.

examples.japanese: {小|ちい}さなミスの{見逃|みのが}しが{大|おお}きな{問題|もんだい}につながる。
examples.english: Overlooking small mistakes leads to big problems.

examples.japanese: {見逃|みのが}し{配信|はいしん}で{昨日|きのう}のドラマを{見|み}た。
examples.english: I watched yesterday's drama on catch-up streaming.

examples.japanese: {見逃|みのが}し{視聴|しちょう}サービスが{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: The catch-up viewing service is convenient.

examples.japanese: あの{番組|ばんぐみ}は{見逃|みのが}し{配信|はいしん}で1{週間|しゅうかん}{無料|むりょう}だ。
examples.english: That program is available free for one week on catch-up.

notes:
FORMS:
{見逃|みのが}す (to overlook, miss) → nominal form
- {見逃|みのが}す (to overlook, to let pass, to miss watching)

SENSE 1 - OVERLOOKING:
- {見逃|みのが}しのない (without missing anything, thorough)
- {見逃|みのが}し{厳禁|げんきん} (don't miss this, must-see)

SENSE 2 - CATCH-UP:
Modern streaming services offer {見逃|みのが}し{配信|はいしん} (catch-up streaming) for people who missed the original broadcast:
- TVer (Japan's major catch-up platform)
- Various broadcaster apps

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {見逃|みのが}し{配信|はいしん} (catch-up streaming/distribution)
- {見逃|みのが}し{視聴|しちょう} (catch-up viewing)
- {見逃|みのが}し{無料|むりょう} (free catch-up viewing)

RELATED WORDS:
- {見落|みお}とす (to overlook - similar meaning)
- オンデマンド (on-demand)
- {録画|ろくが} (recording)
